{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float
# Remove commas and convert to float
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Verify the conversion
print("Revenue converted successfully. First few values:")
print(sales_df['revenue'].head())

# Count completed orders (not refunded)
completed_orders = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed'].shape[0]
refunded_orders = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'refunded'].shape[0]

print(f"Completed orders: {completed_orders}")
print(f"Refunded orders: {refunded_orders}")

# Total orders
print(f"Total orders: {sales_df.shape[0]}")"}
